info.title: API.SH: Expedia
info.description: The Expedia API from API.SH: public Expedia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What Expedia suggests while typing a destination: cities, neighborhoods, landmarks, airports, regions and hotels, each with its id, type, name, full name, coordinates, country and airport code; hotels also with their address and link. A place's `search.region_id` (or full name) works as /expedia/v1/search's region_id (or destination), and a hotel's id works in /expedia/v1/hotel, rooms and reviews.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/expedia-destinations

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place, landmark, airport or hotel name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One hotel as Expedia shows it: name, type, street address, city, region, postal code, country, coordinates, star rating, guest rating with label, review count and the rating for each category, headline facts, the description, popular amenities, every amenity by category, fees and policies (check-in and check-out, children, pets, optional extras, deposits), important information, special features, the neighborhood and nearby places, frequently asked questions with answers, and every photo with its caption.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/expedia-hotel

get.description:
Guest reviews of one hotel on Expedia, 50 per page: overall rating, total reviews and the rating for each category (cleanliness, staff and service, amenities, property condition), then each review with its rating, title, text, language, date, author, who they travelled with, whether the stay was verified, the source, the topics it mentions, helpful votes, guest photos and the hotel's response. Sort by newest, highest or lowest rated, or most relevant; `q` finds reviews that mention a word. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/expedia-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A hotel id from a search answer (e.g. `423330`) or an Expedia link (…/New-York-Hotels-Hilton-New-York-Times-Square.h423330.Hotel-Information).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Review order: newest (default), highest, lowest or relevant.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only reviews that mention this word or phrase (up to 100 characters).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (50 reviews per page, default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The rooms Expedia offers at one hotel for a stay, with prices in euros (Expedia's European English site): each room with its name, size, beds, occupancy, features, amenities by category and photos, and each rate with its cancellation terms (refundable or not, and until when), extras (breakfast, parking...) with their surcharge, price for the stay and per night, any struck-through price, price notes, payment options (pay now, pay later, deposit) and how many rooms are left; plus the lowest price. Without dates the stay is two nights, 30 days from today.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/expedia-rooms

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A hotel id from a search answer (e.g. `423330`) or an Expedia link (…/New-York-Hotels-Hilton-New-York-Times-Square.h423330.Hotel-Information).

parameters.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 days from today.

parameters.name: check_out

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Children's ages per room, comma-separated, e.g. `4,7`.

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Number of rooms, each with the same guests (default 1, max 8).

get.description:
Hotels and other stays Expedia lists for a destination: property id, name, link, area, star rating, guest rating with label and review count, price for the stay (with the nightly price and any struck-through price, in euros (Expedia's European English site)), price notes, availability notes, sponsored flag, badges and photos. Give dates for prices. Filter by star rating, guest rating, nightly price range, amenities, property type, meal plans, free cancellation, payment options, accessibility, room views, room amenities, bedrooms, traveler experience, neighborhood, brand, hotel name and availability; every answer also carries the site's own `filters` list (values, labels and which param takes them, including neighborhood and brand ids for that destination). Sort by recommended, price, guest rating, distance, deals or star class. 50 hotels per page: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/expedia-search

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: City, area, landmark, airport or address, e.g. `London`, `Times Square, New York`, `JFK`. Or pass region_id.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: A region id from /expedia/v1/destinations (instead of destination).

parameters.name: check_in
parameters.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD); with check_out, prices are for the stay.

parameters.name: check_out
parameters.description: Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 28 nights after check_in.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Children's ages per room, comma-separated, e.g. `4,7`.

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Number of rooms, each with the same guests (default 1, max 8).

parameters.name: property_types
parameters.description: Comma-separated: `hotel`, `hotel_resort`, `apartment`, `apart_hotel`, `bed_and_breakfast`, `motel`, `hostel`, `guest_house`, `inn`, `villa`, `vacation_home`, `condo`, `cabin`, `cottage`, `capsule_hotel` and the other values in `filters`.

parameters.name: hotel_name
parameters.description: Only hotels whose name contains this text, e.g. `hilton`.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: `true`: only stays available for the dates.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.
